content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officials working in the Central Govt. Offices holding:; (a) Analogous post on regular basis in the Parent Cadre or Department; (b) Upper Division Clerk or equivalent with 10 years of regular service in the grade; (c) Possessing two years' experience of Establishment, Administration and Accounts work Experience: Two years' experience of Establishment, Administration and Accounts work; for UDC or equivalent, 10 years of regular service in the grade Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of the application) Other conditions: Only officials working in Central Govt. offices may apply. Only willing and eligible candidates who could be spared immediately may be forwarded.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for CPDO (ER) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications not submitted through the proper channel will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on deputation basis. Deputation period, including preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. General terms of deputation as per DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay 11) dt. 17-06-2010, as amended.

content_sections.text: Application in prescribed format (Annexure-I) Certificate by forwarding authority/Parent Department/Cadre Controlling Authority (Annexure-II) Copy of vigilance clearance Details of major/minor penalty during last 10 years (Annexure-III) Attested photocopies of APARs for the last five years

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CPDO (ER) Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format at Annexure-I, showing service particulars, experience and educational qualifications. Parent Department/Cadre Controlling Authority forwards the application with the certificate in Annexure-II. Attach copy of vigilance clearance, details of major/minor penalty (Annexure-III) and attested photocopies of APARs for the last five years. Send through proper channel to the office of the Deputy Commissioner, CPDO (ER), Talagada, Naraj, Cuttack (Odisha) on or before 25 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete application shall be rejected without any further correspondence. Cadre Controlling Authority must issue vigilance clearance and a certificate that no disciplinary case is pending or contemplated.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CPDO (ER) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CPDO (ER) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Office Superintendent (General Central Service, Group B, Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CPDO (ER) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I (Application Form/Proforma) in this notice) and send it to Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Central Poultry Development Organization (ER), Talagada, Naraj, Dist.- Cuttack, PIN - 754006 (Odisha), by through proper channel, forwarded by the parent department/cadre controlling authority, to reach by 25 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of the application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Level-6 (Rs.35400-112400) in the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officials working in Central Govt. offices holding: (a) analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; (b) Upper Division Clerk or equivalent with 10 years of regular service in the grade; (c) two years' experience of Establishment, Administration and Accounts work.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officials working in Central Govt. offices may apply. Only willing and eligible candidates who could be spared immediately may be forwarded.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications not submitted through the proper channel will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on deputation basis. Deputation period, including preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. General terms of deputation as per DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay 11) dt. 17-06-2010, as amended.
